nodes.label: Title slide reference screen
nodes.rationale: Standalone 1920x1080 ar/rtl harness that renders only the title frame from the shared deck fixture, so the cover can be reviewed in isolation from the nine-frame walkthrough.

nodes.label: SlideTitle frame (cover)
nodes.rationale: Cover anatomy is fixed: hero wordmark, program line, subtitle, presenter block (name/role/org) and the endorsement org line - so every day of the bootcamp opens identically.

nodes.label: dsCard screen annotation convention
nodes.rationale: Each reference screen opens with an HTML comment carrying group, viewport and a name/subtitle pair - the subtitle is where the frame's intent is recorded, so the catalogue can be generated and the why travels with the file.
